# 1. 1727 Ottoman Muteferrika Imperial Press Ferman
oe_sci_dec_muteferrika_ferman = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1450
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_dec_muteferrika_done }
		OR = {
			tag = TUR
			owns = location:constantinople
			AND = {
				exists = religion
				OR = {
					religion = religion:sunni
					religion = religion:shia
					religion = religion:ibadi
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_sci_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1700
			has_advance = printing_press_advance
			has_advance = oe_sci_adv_secular_imperial_press
		}
		gold >= 180
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_sci_dec_muteferrika_ferman.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -180
			oe_sci_found_muteferrika_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
